sourcePolicy: Verified product references in this file are meant for educational guidance only. Always cross-check against the official product label and local extension advice before use.

entries.purpose: Protects tomato plants against early blight by reducing fungal spread on foliage.
entries.applicationGuidance: Apply as a foliar spray as per label instructions and local advisory. Reapply only according to the product label and extension recommendations.
entries.safety: Use protective gear, avoid drift, and keep away from water sources and bees. Read the label before use.

entries.purpose: Helps manage late blight on tomato foliage and stems.
entries.applicationGuidance: Use as a foliar spray following label directions and local crop stage guidance.
entries.safety: Do not enter treated fields before the safe re-entry interval specified on the label.

entries.purpose: Targets bollworm and similar chewing pests in cotton.
entries.applicationGuidance: Apply as a foliar spray at the recommended crop stage and rate. Follow label instructions and local advisories.
entries.safety: Avoid spray drift, keep away from water bodies, and use protective clothing.
